split_alignment.basis: Pinned split hash + W4 emitter sequential local_row + all native truths match

case_analysis.selection_method: Round robin over native-prediction/restrict-trigger strata, descending maximum restrict margin then private local_row; not representative sampling.
case_analysis.surface_feature_method: Fixed coarse regex booleans; no semantic/causal interpretation or harmfulness re-labeling.

public_cases.improvement_hypothesis: Privately review label/context and threshold margins; compare approved Validation candidate routing; do not tune on TEST or infer calibrated harm probability.
public_cases.content_review_scope: Deterministic surface features only; no human semantic adjudication or causal explanation.
